step1.message: Open amoCRM on the 'Tasks' page (/todo) — the extension will automatically collect deals.

step2.message: Hover over a deal name — a status panel will appear.

step3.message: Select a status — the deal will be saved in the local database.

step4.message: Open the sidebar (the 'Panel' button on the right) — there you will find statistics, search, and filters.

step5.message: In the Popup (extension icon) you can set up a quick filter for badge display (without changing the database), enable task grouping by date, and go to Settings to configure your global status profile.

logicTodoNew.message: New deal: added to DB with '✨ New' status.

logicTodoExisting.message: Deal already in DB: metadata is updated, but status is not reset.

logicDetailInDb.message: Deal in DB: shows your status. Changing status updates the DB.

logicDetailWild.message: Deal not in DB (Wild 🍒): selecting a status automatically adds it to DB.

logicProfiles.message: Status profiles: if you hide a status in Settings or Popup, deals with this status will not be displayed on the page and in the sidebar, but will remain in the database. You can bring them back at any time by checking the box again.

helpTechIntro.message: If amoCRM changes its markup and the extension stops finding elements, check these selectors in the code (src/shared/constants.ts):

helpTechTodoDesc.message: Searches only for deal links within the task list (class js-navigate-link and href with /leads/detail/).

helpTechDetailDesc.message: Searches for the deal name field (textarea#person_n). The ID is extracted from the span.tag.

helpTechLeadId.message: The deal ID is extracted from the href attribute (the number after /leads/detail/) or from the span.tag on the deal page.

helpTechSyncDesc.message: The extension uses a combination of background and content scripts to track changes:

helpTechSyncList.message:
1. chrome.webNavigation (in background.ts) — catches any SPA navigation (including pagination on /todo and page switching) as it intercepts pushState/replaceState at the browser level.
2. MutationObserver (in content/index.ts) — watches document.body and serves as a fallback for modal windows (when the URL doesn't change but textarea#person_n appears).

helpTechSyncDebounce.message: Delay: After a URL change, the extension waits 100ms to let amoCRM render new rows in the DOM, and only then starts collecting data.

integrationPagesIntro.message: The extension works on three types of amoCRM pages. For each: trigger, selector, and what we parse.

integrationPageTodoDesc.message: Triggers: spinner #page_change_progress (class stopped), MutationObserver on #list_table, fallback via chrome.webNavigation (1 sec).

integrationPageDetailDesc.message: Trigger: appearance of textarea#person_n. Badge rendering only, no collection.

integrationStep1.message: User clicks 'Tasks' → amoCRM changes URL via pushState.

integrationStep2.message: chrome.webNavigation catches URL change and sends urlChanged to content script.

integrationStep3.message: Content script waits for spinner #page_change_progress (class stopped) to disappear or 1 sec.

integrationStep4.message: refresh() is called: collectNewClients() collects visible rows, buildClientIndexes() rebuilds indexes, render() applies badges.

integrationStep5.message: MutationObserver on #list_table serves as fallback if something was missed.

integrationFailSpinnerDesc.message: If amoCRM renames the spinner ID, the main trigger stops working. Fix: update ID in content/index.ts (startPageLoaderObserver).

integrationFailSelectorsDesc.message: If amoCRM changes link class (a.js-navigate-link), deal collection stops. Fix: update SELECTORS in shared/constants.ts.

integrationFailContainerDesc.message: If amoCRM renames the list container, MutationObserver won't fire. Fix: update selector in startDomObserver (content/index.ts).

integrationFailTitleDesc.message: If amoCRM stops writing name to title or value, name parsing breaks. Fix: update extractNameFromElement in shared/utils/parsers.ts.

integrationDiagDesc.message: Enable diagnostics in settings → logs are stored in chrome.storage.local (500 entries buffer). Download log → click 'Download log'. In the log you can see: RENDER (how many elements found), COLLECT (how many collected), STABILIZATION (how long waited), PAGE_LOADER (when spinner fired).

integrationSelectorTodoDesc.message: Searches only for deal links within the task list (class js-navigate-link and href with /leads/detail/).

integrationSelectorDetailDesc.message: Searches for the deal name field (textarea#person_n). ID is extracted from the span.tag.

integrationLeadIdNote.message: The deal ID is extracted from the href attribute (the number after /leads/detail/) or from the span.tag on the deal page.

integrationReqTodoFunnel.message: Column 'Deal stage' (or funnel) — recommended (for product grouping).

integrationRaceDesc.message: amoCRM is a SPA. When navigating from 'Companies' to 'Tasks', the URL changes instantly, but the old DOM tree (companies table) is still on screen. To prevent the extension from collecting data from the old table, a three-level protection is used:

integrationRaceStep1.message: 1. Delay (800 ms): after a URL change, the script waits for amoCRM to redraw the page.

integrationRaceStep2.message: 2. Page Marker Check: the script collects data only if the page has the exact DOM marker (active link to /todo or /leads/list).

integrationRaceStep3.message: 3. MutationObserver (Last resort): if the tree redraws with a delay and the script missed the new tasks, the Observer will catch the new rows and trigger collection again.

integrationMarkerDesc.message: To avoid collecting data from wrong pages (due to SPA render delays), the extension uses exact DOM markers that exist only on specific pages:

integrationMarkerTodo.message: Tasks page (/todo): a.list-top-nav__icon-button_active[href*="/todo/list/"]. This element is only in the task list header.

integrationMarkerLeads.message: Deals page (/leads/list/ and pipelines): a.list-top-nav__icon-button_active[href^="/leads/list/"]. The ^= (starts with) attribute allows capturing both 'All deals' and any specific pipeline.

integrationMarkerNote.message: If these markers are not found, the script aborts data collection even if the URL has already changed. This protects the database from phantom records.
